name: eq_zero_of_eval_zero_at_prod_finset
statement: Type*} [Finite σ] [IsDomain R] (P : MvPolynomial σ R) (S : σ → Finset R) (Hdeg : ∀ i, P.degreeOf i < #(S i)) (Heval : ∀ (x : σ → R), (∀ i, x i ∈ S i) → eval x P = 0) : P = 0

name: combinatorial_nullstellensatz_exists_eval_nonzero
statement: MvPolynomial σ R) (t : σ →₀ ℕ) (ht : f.coeff t ≠ 0) (ht' : f.totalDegree = t.degree) (S : σ → Finset R) (htS : ∀ i, t i < #(S i)) : ∃ s : σ → R, (∀ i, s i ∈ S i) ∧ eval s f ≠ 0
